name: NativeBridge.Incremental.proj1SigOfSig2EqNative

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.sigOfSig2EqNative
native_expression:
∀ (A : Sort u) (P Q : A → Prop) (s t : { x // P x ∧ Q x }),
  s = t → NativeBridge.Incremental.dropSecondProperty s = NativeBridge.Incremental.dropSecondProperty t

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.eqSig2HpropNative

∀ (A : Sort u) (P Q : A → Prop),
  (∀ (x : A) (p q : Q x), p = q) →
    ∀ (s t : { x // P x ∧ Q x }),
      NativeBridge.Incremental.dropSecondProperty s = NativeBridge.Incremental.dropSecondProperty t → s = t

name: NativeBridge.Incremental.eqSig2HpropIffNative
native_expression:
